relation.note: The subject witnessed the ijāza granted by him to his son in 828 AH.
The recipient of the ijāza witnessed by the subject in 828 AH.

event.desc: He witnessed the ijāza (authorization) granted by ʿAlī b. Mūsā to his son Amīn al-Dīn Muḥammad in the variant readings (al-qirāʾāt) and wrote his witnessing in verse.
event.note: Mentioned as the year twenty-eight (828 AH).

person.note: アリー・ビン・ムハンマド・アル＝ムハージリー・アル＝ムクリー。私は、彼がヒジュラ暦828年にアリー・ビン・ムーサーがその息子アミーン・アッ＝ディーン・ムハンマドに下した諸朗誦法（キラーアート）のイジャーザ（授権状）に証人として立ち会い、その証言を詩の形式で書き残しているのを見た。その詩には次のようにあった。「神が私と、聴衆と、去りゆきし過去の罪からアミーンと言う者を赦したまわんことを」

ʿAlī b. Muḥammad al-Muhājirī al-Muqrī. I saw him witnessing the ijāza (authorization) granted by ʿAlī b. Mūsā to his son Amīn al-Dīn Muḥammad in the variant readings (al-qirāʾāt) in the year 828 AH. He wrote his witnessing in verse, which included: 'And may God forgive me, the listeners, and whoever says Amen, for the sins that have passed and gone.'
